ORAL JUDGMENT

These appeals are filed by the claimants under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, (for short,
'the Act') being aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 28.02.2018 passed by the VII Additional Judge & XXXII ACMM, Court of Small Causes, Bangalore (SCCH-3), (for short 'the Tribunal') in MVC Nos.1103/2017 and 1104/2017.

sentences.text: Since the challenge is to the same judgment, both the appeals are clubbed together, heard and common judgment is being passed.

Facts giving rise to the filing of the appeal briefly stated are that on 27.11.2016 at about 3.00 p.m.,
when the deceased Manik Raj and Manoj Kumar were proceeding on a motorcycle bearing registration No.KA-01/HQ-8906 from Kolar side towards Hoskote side, when they reached near MVJ Hospital, Hoskote, at that time, a lorry bearing registration No.WB-65/B-7398 which was being driven in a rash and negligent manner, dashed against the motorcycle As a result of the aforesaid accident, both the deceased sustained grievous injuries and succumbed to the injuries.
3.
The claimants filed petitions under Section 166 of the Act seeking compensation for the death of the deceased along with interest.
4. Upon service of notice, the respondent Nos.1 and 2 appeared through counsel and filed separate written statements denying the averments made in the claim petition.

The claimants, in order to prove the case, examined claimant No.1 in both the cases as PW-1 and PW-2, and another witness as PW-2, and got exhibited documents namely Ex.P1 to Ex.P35.
On behalf of respondents, neither any witness was examined nor got exhibited documents.
The Claims Tribunal, by the impugned judgment, inter alia

, held that the accident took place on account of rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle by its driver, as a result of which, the deceased sustained injuries and succumbed to the injuries.

The Tribunal further held that the claimants are entitled to a compensation of Rs.11,10,000/- and Rs.9,35,100/-, respectively, along with interest at the rate of 8% p.a. and directed the Insurance Company to deposit the compensation amount along with interest.
Being aggrieved, these appeals have been filed.
